tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, sheets and inputs, on `ground`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: segmented-control track, disabled inputs, skeletons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders that must be seen (3:1 on `surface` and `ground`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and placeholders on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active tab, links and focus ring, on `surface` and `ground`. Indigo (neel).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chip and avatar fallback fill; `brand` text reads on it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Marigold. One highlight per screen: the Pay via UPI button, the unread badge, the split dial. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Pending and awaiting-confirmation pills; pair with `pending` text.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Text for pending and marked-paid states on `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Money owed to the user: amounts and the words 'you are owed', on `surface`, `ground` and `positive-soft`. Also completed settlements.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of 'you are owed' pills and confirmed states.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Money the user owes: amounts and the words 'you owe', on `surface`, `ground` and `negative-soft`.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Background of 'you owe' pills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions and declined settlements, on `surface`. Never used for balances.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: auth headline, group name on Group Detail.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings and list row titles.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names and emphasised words inside body text; button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, tab labels, pill text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row metadata and helper text. Smallest size allowed.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase date dividers in feeds. Nothing else.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: The single hero figure: overall balance on Home, amount on Settle Up and Add Expense.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Expense total in a detail header.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in list rows and split previews.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap; pill vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding; gap between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of screen to first block; empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target height; avatar-large size.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented-control segments, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners only) and the QR panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, badges, the FAB.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: FAB and bottom sheets only. Cards and rows use `line`, not shadow.
